title: Completed acquisition versus unread donors, third-gathering fallbacks, stock quotes and ordinary entry
head: be24c225c00cf8c583bf7773ee124d354b91e88b

reviews.classification: historical supersession / bounded route evidence / missing downstream consumer
reviews.disposition:
Historical scout/acquisition chronology under AD32/AD35/AD36. Read the execution-update banner and entire original scout: the later61-target downloaded/archive-verified state supersedes the lower not-all-downloaded paragraph and Prominence metadata-only state at the acquisition level. It does not establish all61 semantically read, compatible, installed or played. Keep the completion report/receipts as that later owner's evidence rather than retroactively making the initial sample a full download run. Thirty-eight title matches plus21 unresolved original/additional targets gives59, plus Cabricality/Prominence gives61; exact title still does not establish publisher, edition or compatibility.

F9–F11/O1–O4 preserve static research corpus versus playable selected packs. A mrpack can be a manifest/overrides with external/manual dependencies; it is not a self-contained verified installation or inherently small. Cabricality's checksum and53-member/16-quest/51-external-entry index are selected archive facts, not all quest semantics or custom-code coverage. Missing script filename patterns do not prove absent behavior. The inspired Quilt pack is not original Above and Beyond. Old metadata byte totals are not installed footprint, runtime, energy or timing estimates. No fresh public source fetch or current catalog verification occurred here.

All N28–N45 donor questions and A5–A10 remain useful, with current/source/port/addon/translation/future-plan distinctions. Factory Tech's guessed-source failure remains failure, Totemic publisher/edition is unverified at this scout scope, ElementalCraft's selected older edition is not current parity, and Hexerei/Eidolon's author plans are not delivered features. Preserve automation convenience, real predicates/custody, crystal preparation, group performance, spell composition, local imported gear law, pocket return, keys, constructed companions, cauldrons and quest/talent consumers as proposed research questions. Hash dedup preserves separate manifests/roles rather than flattening paths/layers. The old bulk downloader choices and later downloaded status do not authorize acquisition, install, workers or a new universal source/gameplay wave now. Full-body content review reads no archives, JAR/source classes, linked completion/index JSON, game or personal save.

reviews.classification: historical supersession / bounded route evidence / missing downstream consumer
reviews.disposition:
Historical16-act third-gathering continuation under AD36/AD42/AD43. Preserve the actual source-window/scene table and intentionally unbuilt unwitnessed passages; source character knowledge is not narrator omniscience. The1034-minute authored durations sum to the15770→16804 clock change; the asserted2:58 anchor is one qualified civil point, not complete native civil-time fidelity. Money799 remains unchanged because an unspecified more-than-enough stamp allowance gives no numerical debit. Earlier2-pence club-share/tip debt remains pending rather than silently settled by this window.

The third remoteSessions pack entry, active fact, reused seats, closed earlier sessions and alias checks are a concrete data consumer on the pinned master bundle, not a new repo registry or arbitrary session-support proof. The mechanism row's hall-through-symbol-start wording must be read against its explicit closed-from-chat and the verification's active-only-link-to-chat statement: the phase boundary is the actual close command/assertions, not a claim that symbol afterward reopens the seats. No fresh runtime trace is inspected here to resolve a different event order. Keep home anchor drift from Narcissus Street to Moretti flat as an open identity/content issue, not source-authenticated relocation just because the route passed.

Pool refill/spend is actual bounded metering, while B3 practice/taps, R5 taught rite/redirected chant and B2 unobserved presentation remain facts/fallbacks rather than those full engines. B4/B5/R1/B6/R9 were not exercised. The next two clients do not become actual paid B6 sessions merely through cards when BE_CLIENTS still has anna. Sixteen per-act checks on a seeded KJ3AA run and end literal import retain their build/pack identity; no RESUME join, post-import repeat reload,14/21 visuals, ordinary start or full suite/build is claimed. A rules command listed before commit lacks an explicit result in this table and is not a new passing run here. Prescans/trimmed strings and leak regex are bounded format/sentinel checks, not primary-source or all-disclosure proof. No private window, proof bundle, pack, source or runtime was read during this full public receipt review.

reviews.classification: historical supersession / bounded route evidence / missing downstream consumer
reviews.disposition:
Historical paired receipt/projection delivery under AD36/AD42/AD43. K1 persists mixture lastCompletion because acquisition receipts/cleared jobs cannot recover consumed inputs; work-plan lastResult is instead a view of the existing audience-scoped log. Preserve absent-field inert compatibility and old-build field acceptance at its inspected validator identity, not a general claim that every optional future field is backward compatible. A100-entry evicted log result legitimately becomes none-recorded, not evidence the job never completed or authority to infer consumed input after the job is gone.

K2 steep/boil quote the same selected stock into distinct actual products, with carried/held/blocked/free from native disposition. Mixing-vessel holds and borrowed/committed custody are distinct from craft goals; blocking a whole key follows the incumbent disposition consumer. The actual borrowed-spend defect is reported repaired through admission token/reservation, not a new duplicate custody owner. Committing one quote stales the other without spending again. Batch completion receipt uses the completed batch's held input, not the next reserved batch. Buy/cancel do not overwrite the last earned receipt.

The2561 full-suite pass and six-case headless journeys retain the mixed dirty-tree bundle identity, not an isolated own-path-only runtime. Generated fixture history is not natural acquisition. The three-size/two-font ready cases precede reload; persistence ran at1920 because the1536/21 stacked-shell reload covered the launcher. Do not convert all six ready successes into six persistence passes or claim the shared-shell issue repaired here. Small type role and cross-system sell/native-recipe destinations remain open; RF5/one-herb-two-products closure does not close all Potionomics/Stardew destinations. Original guarded own-path commit is recorded authority/action, not a present instruction to commit or publish. Current full-body review inspects none of the linked screenshots/source/test/artifact bytes and adds no fresh runtime/install/human proof.

reviews.classification: historical supersession / bounded route evidence / missing downstream consumer
reviews.disposition:
Historical bounded ordinary Tingen choice/purse delivery under AD36/AD42/AD43 and WER. Preserve three axes and nine answers, one written option per axis plus explicitly unwritten alternatives, deliberate preview/Back/confirm and fresh Village crossing. The chosen probationer host's480-pence purse and civil in-person1200-pence purse are different local starts; the102 Village money is recorded left behind, not converted, duplicated or already returned. Proposed two-pound amount is authored, not a complete canonical wealth claim. Existing enrolled saves without entry retain old money; new optional entry records produce the explicitly forward-only older-reader refusal boundary.

The start-confirm/purse reaches a real native price/wage consumer. The entry record/leftBehind has no downstream return consumer here, so a persisted field is not a playable AD12 reciprocal return. Shared Your beginning integration, cocoon/by-design, later era, young hosts and inventory currency units remain this older slice's separate gaps. Later KJ2's developer-menu/ordinary-start policy belongs to a distinct lead route and its later authority; this older ordinary clerk/civil evidence does not make the source-protagonist route an ordinary supported start. Launch PLAY versus in-world selection remains the recorded visible scope.

Browser probationer and MCP civil walks are two tested cases at different routes, not one combined native/browser replay of every life. Rebuilt1920/1536 ×14/21 and literal persistence support the named bounded confirm/purse claim; leftBehind display/use remains absent. The141 focused cases overlap with the3494 final suite. Script receipt route:natural is this actual fresh Village-to-choice route, not proof all omitted starts/eras/source windows work. No current linked evidence, source file, private save, installed app or runtime was inspected by this complete checkpoint review. Old next-order priorities/commit state and enrollment default do not override later current campaign direction or authorize new gameplay work.
